findings: Source figures show the mast eyelet, single-screw wire clamp, open turnbuckle, S hook and stake connection topology. The loose candidates retain real eyes, two wire channels, open hook mouths and a screwdriver recess.
All local component profiles and dimensions except explicitly recorded catalogue facts remain authored hypotheses; no manufacturer CAD or exact silhouette match is asserted.
The 4 ft rod and two distinct nominal stake diameters are retained. Stake lengths, J-heads, rod diameter and finish are selected hypotheses.

Two uncut continuous wire spirals lie on a common plane. Static measured lengths are 15.24 m and the selected 3 m, with positive nonlocal clearance. They do not establish tension, flexibility or grounding performance.
The face-side views show a real crossed recess in the wire-clamp screw and a separate hex bolt in the ground clamp; the selected loose fit does not qualify wire gripping force.

Reinspection shows a wider S-hook bend with 16 mm nominal clear inner diameter; the old 12 mm opening conflicted with the 12.7 mm stake. Isolated eye-envelope fits are now checked, but the hook-mouth assembly trajectory remains unqualified.

The mast-ground saddle now has a wire groove outside the 41 mm mast envelope. The oblique loose view shows the groove and separated U-bolt/nuts; the installed reference shows the continuous wire passing through that groove.
geometry_limits: Displayed poses are inspection arrangements, not laboratory inventory or a completed weather station.
Cable channels, eyes and simplified thread envelopes do not certify contact, preload, retention, fatigue, pull-out or electrical continuity.

An earthen-site candidate and a separate installed support reference now show loops, tails, measured cut lengths and grounding route. Complete station integration, initial stock, device routing and physical qualification remain incomplete.

rejected_predecessor.observed_problem: The 8 mm centreline hook bend leaves only a 12 mm opening for the 12.7 mm stake. The retained historical geometry produced a 15.95139782907795 mm3 stake-envelope intersection in the selected isolated fit.
